sentence: This project studies how a shared mutation in a cancer gene can trigger a specific immune response.
This project builds statistical tools that use large collections of genomic and environmental data to study how complex traits evolved.
This project studies how one gene holds back interferon signaling during influenza virus infection and lung inflammation.
This project uses deep learning to find features in multimodal data that predict which children keep having psychotic-like experiences.
This project works on biomedical imaging tools that show genes, proteins, cells and tissues in health and disease.
This project tests whether MRI and ultrasound imaging can detect and predict damage to transplanted kidneys in children.
This project studies why some adolescents with temporomandibular disorders also get migraines, using molecular, sensory, clinical and psychosocial data.
This project works on using genomics and bioinformatics research to help control HIV infection in children.
This project builds a mouse model that mimics how tuberculosis bacteria spread through respiratory droplets from one host to another.
This project sets up a shared facility that uses super-resolution light microscopy to image subcellular structures in fixed and living cells.
This project tries to find ways to improve outcomes for critically ill patients.
This project studies which genetic variants make ibrutinib-treated cancer patients prone to cardiovascular toxicities, using stem cells made from patients.
This project studies how faulty cholinergic signaling in the brain leads to compulsive motor behaviors.
This project builds an organ-on-a-chip model that recreates how oral squamous cell carcinoma invades bone.
This project tests whether an app-based mindfulness program that targets skills for regulating negative affect prevents anxiety and depression in at-risk adolescents.
This project uses modeling methods to guide policies on tobacco use, e-cigarettes, lung cancer screening and treatment.
This project studies how regulatory T cells affect bronchopulmonary dysplasia with pulmonary hypertension in premature infants.
This project studies how large DNA insertions at one chromosome site cause hereditary eye and brain malformations, using patient-derived stem cells.
This project builds a chemical proteomics platform that maps how proteins interact with each other in living cells.
This project tests whether changing how neurons and other cells take up cholesterol helps axons regrow after spinal cord injury.
